name: llima
description: SiMa.ai Lean Language & Image Modalix Application

installation.script: rm -Rf ~/.cache && mkdir -p simaai-genai-demo/models && rm -Rf simaai-genai-demo/gte-small-local simaai-genai-demo/models/gte-small-local && if [ -d gte-small-local/gte-small-local ]; then mv gte-small-local/gte-small-local simaai-genai-demo/models/; elif [ -d gts-small-local/gte-small-local ]; then mv gts-small-local/gte-small-local simaai-genai-demo/models/; fi && cd simaai-genai-demo && ./install.sh && rm -Rf ~/.cache
installation.post-message:
[bold]To run this package:[/bold]

1. [green]cd simaai-genai-demo[/green]
2. [green]./run.sh[/green] (in web interaction mode)
3. [green]./run.sh -cli[/green] (in CLI mode)
